news.title: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
news.summary: Anthropic is hiring fewer and fewer junior staff in technical roles. The share of junior positions among new hires dropped from 27 to 9 percent since early 2025.

news.title: Anthropic consults law firms to set fair negotiation norms before AI agents start cutting deals
news.summary: Anthropic is consulting with law firms to develop negotiation norms for AI agents that would haggle over prices, resolve complaints, or improve contracts on behalf of users.

news.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help
news.summary: Four AI agents running on Google's Gemini 4 Argon have beaten Minecraft for the first time without human help, slaying the Ender Dragon in a fully autonomous run.

news.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
news.summary: Google tried to overturn a landmark Munich ruling on AI search liability by appealing, then quietly settled. The strategy isn't working.

news.title: AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it
news.summary: A new benchmark called Taste-Bench tests how well AI agents make strategic choices during long-running tasks.

news.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
news.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data.

news.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
news.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them.
